svg.aria-label: From the top of the hour to a dependency pull request: 1. Mint: An ExternalSecret builds the GitHub App key from 1Password item renovate. The job exchanges it for an installation token. 2. Discover: The RenovateJob home-ops runs at minute zero and finds skrumbach/home-ops through the App installation. 3. Update: Renovate reads the repo config and opens one pull request per dependency change, with platform commits on. 4. Record: Each run is a Job kept for 24 hours. A failed run is not retried; the next hourly run is the retry. 5. Alarm: Five rules cover failed runs, missing runs, empty discovery, a suspended job and an absent operator.
